value_updates.referral_explanation: Explain that a mint number is the permanent referral code, that every successful primary mint after mint number one generates one $5 commission and one Small Block ticket, that a valid referral assigns them to the referrer, and that a no-code or invalid-code mint assigns them to a random existing NFT holder; mint number one awards neither because no prior NFT holder exists, and secondary-market sales are excluded.
value_updates.ticket_explanation: Explain that every successful primary mint after mint number one generates one on-chain Small Block ticket for the current $500 draw, with referral tickets assigned to the referrer and no-code or invalid-code tickets assigned to a random existing NFT holder; mint number one generates no ticket because no prior NFT holder exists, secondary-market sales generate no tickets, tickets expire after their draw, and later primary mints generate tickets for later draws.

decisions.reason: The Mission page's prize copy universally assigns a ticket to every primary mint and therefore omits the accepted first-mint exception.

value_updates.prize_pools_copy: One eligible ticket holder from each 100-sales block wins $500 through a fair Chainlink VRF draw; every successful primary mint after mint number one provides one ticket, no-code or invalid-code tickets are assigned to a random existing NFT holder, mint number one provides no ticket because no prior NFT holder exists, secondary-market sales provide no tickets, and more tickets provide more chances to win.

decisions.reason: The accepted first-mint exception changes ticket issuance, not how holders of generated tickets are selected as winners.
A same-message MODIFY already records that mint number one receives neither a commission nor a ticket because no prior NFT holder exists.
A same-message MODIFY already records that ticket generation begins after the first mint and that mint number one receives no ticket.

The existing same-message Event records that mint number one pays no referral commission, but the supplied evidence does not establish where that otherwise allocated $5 goes, leaving the first-mint revenue allocation incomplete.
The first-mint ticket and commission exception does not change automatic prize payout or winner-notification behavior.
A same-message MODIFY already limits the aggregate accounting rule to mints after mint number one and records the first-mint exception.
The hero describes referral rewards and recurring draws; the one-time first-mint exception does not require a change to this promotional copy.
The accepted exception does not change fiat-buyer wallet provisioning, asset custody, authentication, or reward access.
The metadata requirement governs accurate display of rewards that were assigned; it does not require a reward attribute for the first mint when no reward was assigned.
The first-mint referral-reward exception does not change the Transak provider, payment conversion, supported methods, or NFT fulfillment flow.
